issues.where: the dark cloud band and warm sunset sky just above the horizon in the -b crop
issues.what: visible rectangular macroblocks step across the dark horizon smudge and pale orange-gray sky gradient, and the mist over the water turns mushy
issues.fix: raise the video bitrate (or lower CRF) and use 10-bit encoding with gentle dithering so low-contrast horizon gradients do not block

issues.where: the lightning forks, translucent ribbon edges, and dark storm clouds in the center -b crop
issues.what: fine secondary lightning branches and lacy ribbon outlines soften and smear with faint ringing, while the dark clouds behind them flatten into blotchy patches
issues.fix: reduce compression strength and preserve fine high-frequency edges with gentler quantization and adaptive quantization tuned for dark areas

issues.where: the dark storm clouds and thin wires with hanging icicles in the top-left -b crop
issues.what: cloud gradients smooth into slightly blocky patches and the thin wires and tiny icicles blur and lose crispness with mild mosquito noise
issues.fix: allocate more bits to dark cloud texture and thin high-contrast lines by lowering CRF or increasing bitrate

issues.where: the thin wire stretching to the distant peak and the sea mist below it in the bottom-center -b crop
issues.what: tiny icicles along the wire soften into faint smudges and the misty water loses fine detail compared to the uncompressed frame
issues.fix: use a higher bitrate or slower encoder preset to retain fine edge detail and subtle mist texture
